application_place.name: application_place
application_place.value: ("application"."cloud_account_id" IS NULL) = ("application"."region" IS NULL) AND ("application"."cloud_account_id" IS NULL OR "application"."server_id" IS NULL)

application_cron_timetable.name: application_cron_timetable
application_cron_timetable.value: ("application"."config_kind" = 'cron') = ("application"."cron_schedule" IS NOT NULL) AND ("application"."cron_schedule" IS NULL) = ("application"."cron_timezone" IS NULL) AND ("application"."cron_schedule" IS NULL) = ("application"."cron_timeout_seconds" IS NULL)

backup_parent_matches_type.name: backup_parent_matches_type
backup_parent_matches_type.value:
num_nonnulls("compose_id", "postgres_id", "mariadb_id", "mysql_id", "mongo_id", "libsql_id") = 1
    AND (CASE
           WHEN "backup_type" = 'compose'     THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'postgres'  THEN "postgres_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mariadb'   THEN "mariadb_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mysql'     THEN "mysql_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'mongo'     THEN "mongo_id"
           WHEN "database_type" = 'libsql'    THEN "libsql_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

deployment_preview_qualifies_an_applicat.name: deployment_preview_qualifies_an_application
deployment_preview_qualifies_an_applicat.value: "preview_deployment_id" IS NULL OR "application_id" IS NOT NULL

deployment_cron_run_has_an_application.name: deployment_cron_run_has_an_application
deployment_cron_run_has_an_application.value: "cron_run" IS NULL OR "application_id" IS NOT NULL

mount_parent_matches_service_type.name: mount_parent_matches_service_type
mount_parent_matches_service_type.value:
num_nonnulls("application_id", "compose_id", "libsql_id", "mariadb_id", "mongo_id", "mysql_id", "postgres_id", "redis_id") = 1
    AND (CASE "service_type"
           WHEN 'application' THEN "application_id"
           WHEN 'compose'     THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN 'libsql'      THEN "libsql_id"
           WHEN 'mariadb'     THEN "mariadb_id"
           WHEN 'mongo'       THEN "mongo_id"
           WHEN 'mysql'       THEN "mysql_id"
           WHEN 'postgres'    THEN "postgres_id"
           WHEN 'redis'       THEN "redis_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

preview_deployment_fields_match_trigger.name: preview_deployment_fields_match_trigger
preview_deployment_fields_match_trigger.value: ("preview_deployment"."trigger" = 'pullRequest' AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_number" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_title" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_url" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("preview_deployment"."trigger" = 'requested' AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_id" IS NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_number" IS NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_title" IS NULL AND "preview_deployment"."pull_request_url" IS NULL AND "preview_deployment"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

preview_deployment_expired_is_requested.name: preview_deployment_expired_is_requested
preview_deployment_expired_is_requested.value: ("preview_deployment"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "preview_deployment"."expiry_cause" IS NULL) OR ("preview_deployment"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."expiry_cause" IS NOT NULL AND "preview_deployment"."trigger" = 'requested')

project_config_location_repository_iff_r.name: project_config_location_repository_iff_repository
project_config_location_repository_iff_r.value: ("project_config_location"."kind" = 'repository') = ("project_config_location"."repository" IS NOT NULL AND "project_config_location"."path" IS NOT NULL)

schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type.name: schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type
schedule_parent_matches_schedule_type.value:
num_nonnulls("application_id", "compose_id", "server_id", "organization_id") = 1
    AND (CASE "schedule_type"
           WHEN 'application'      THEN "application_id"
           WHEN 'compose'          THEN "compose_id"
           WHEN 'server'           THEN "server_id"
           WHEN 'cloudgate-server' THEN "organization_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

error_rate_threshold_parent_matches_serv.name: error_rate_threshold_parent_matches_service_type
error_rate_threshold_parent_matches_serv.value:
num_nonnulls("application_id", "compose_id") = 1
    AND (CASE "service_type"
           WHEN 'application' THEN "application_id"
           WHEN 'compose'     THEN "compose_id"
         END) IS NOT NULL

incident_threshold_has_rates.name: incident_threshold_has_rates
incident_threshold_has_rates.value:
("error_rate_threshold_id" IS NULL) = ("opening_error_rate" IS NULL)
    AND ("error_rate_threshold_id" IS NULL) = ("opening_requests" IS NULL)
    AND ("error_rate_threshold_id" IS NULL) = ("worst_error_rate" IS NULL)

uptime_check_tcp_has_port.name: uptime_check_tcp_has_port

uptime_check_header_value_has_name.name: uptime_check_header_value_has_name
uptime_check_header_value_has_name.value: "header_value" IS NULL OR "header_name" IS NOT NULL

trace_store_parent_matches_service_type.name: trace_store_parent_matches_service_type
